title: 7 Must Have Liquor Store POS features in 2026
summary: Outdated POS systems are costing liquor store owners money. Here's what a modern system should do for your liquor store business.
body_markdown:
A surprising number of liquor store owners are still running outdated POS systems, clinging to the mindset of "if it ain't broke, don't fix it." But in the long run, this mentality is costing them money.


If you're running a liquor store and want to maximize your profits, simply using your POS to ring up sales and process payments isn't enough.[The right POS system](https://www.santehq.com/blog/best-pos-system-for-liquor-stores) can do so much more for you, and the returns compound the longer you use it.


Let's go over some of the must-have features your liquor store POS should have.


‍


## #1 AI POS features for liquor stores


Santé POS uses[AI to handle receiving and reordering](https://www.santehq.com/blog/ai-for-liquor-stores) . Instead of manually entering every item off a distributor invoice, you scan it, and Santé's AI extracts the products, quantities, and costs automatically, updating your inventory in minutes instead of hours.


On the reordering side, Santé analyzes your past sales data, current stock levels, and trends to suggest what you should reorder and when, so you're not stuck guessing or manually calculating PARs every week.


‍


## #2 Stock counting and case management for liquor stores


[Inventory counts](https://www.santehq.com/blog/best-way-to-count-inventory-at-your-liquor-store) are notoriously disruptive, and many stores end up closing early or paying overtime just to get an accurate count.


Santé's mobile app lets you spot-check individual sections or run a full recount right from the shop floor, without tying up the register or bringing in outside help. You walk the aisles, scan or search for items, and update counts in real time, so your numbers stay accurate without ever having to close the store.


Case and pack management is built into the same system. A single SKU can be broken down into multiple selling units (case, pack, or single bottle or can), so when a customer buys one beer, Santé automatically adjusts the pack and case counts behind the scenes instead of leaving you to reconcile it by hand.


Santé also includes keg tracking, so kegs, deposits, and deliveries are accounted for automatically rather than living in a separate spreadsheet.


‍


## #3 POS system reporting and analytics for liquor stores


Santé's detailed reporting and sales dashboard pull your sales and inventory numbers into one clear view, so you can see which products are moving, which categories are underperforming, and how discounts or pricing changes are actually affecting your revenue.


‍


## #4 Liquor store promotions and discounts in your POS


Santé's promotions tool lets you set case discounts and mix-and-match deals that apply automatically at checkout, both in-store and online.


You set the rule once (which products qualify, what quantity triggers the discount, and what price it drops to) and Santé applies it the moment a customer's order hits the threshold, with no cashier calculation or manual override needed.


[Promotions](https://www.santehq.com/blog/how-promotions-increase-traffic-for-liquor-stores) also connect to your customer data, so when an item goes on sale or restocks, Santé can trigger[email and SMS campaigns](https://www.santehq.com/blog/increase-liquor-sales-with-email-and-sms-marketing) to customers who buy that category, so the deal reaches people likely to act on it instead of just sitting on a shelf sign.


‍


## #5 Loyalty and gift cards integrated into POS for liquor stores


With Santé, you can create fully customizable[loyalty programs](https://www.santehq.com/blog/loyalty-programs-for-liquor-stores) that reward customers for shopping with you instead of a competitor, whether they're buying beer, wine, or spirits.


You can also sell physical or digital gift cards both in-store and online, giving customers another reason to choose your shop for gifting occasions.


‍


## #6 Multi-location management features for liquor stores


If you run more than one store, managing inventory and sales separately at each location wastes time and creates blind spots.


Santé lets you manage inventory and sales across all your locations from a single dashboard, with seamless inventory transfers between stores, so you always know what you have and where it is, without calling around to check.


‍


## #7 Ecommerce POS features for liquor stores


Santé POS folds ecommerce into the same platform as your register. Upload your inventory, and Santé maps product images, writes product descriptions, and builds your site from ready-made templates.


[Running your online store](https://www.santehq.com/blog/winning-online-why-ecommerce-sales-matter-and-how-to-succeed) as a separate tool from your POS means paying for it twice: once in software costs, and again in the time it takes to keep inventory synced between your register and your website.


A typical liquor store tech stack looks like this:


- In-store POS: $129/month
- eCommerce platform: $99/month
- Payment gateway fee: $79/month (per terminal)
- Delivery app integrations: $49/month


For a 2-register store, running these as separate tools instead of one integrated system costs over $2,600 more per year.


With Santé, checkout is built for conversion, delivery orders from DoorDash, Uber Eats, GrubHub, and Instacart come straight into the system, and email subscriptions bring customers back with special offers, all from the same platform running your register.


‍


## Maximizing Liquor Store Profits with Santé POS


Most of the cost of running an outdated POS setup doesn't show up on an invoice. It shows up as the hours your staff spends re-entering the same data across two systems, the sales you lose when your website says "in stock" and your shelf doesn't, and the[shrinkage that creeps in](https://www.santehq.com/blog/minimize-inventory-losses-liquor-store) when nobody has full visibility into what's actually happening at the register.


Every feature covered in this article runs inside one platform with Santé. AI receiving cuts down invoice entry, smart reordering keeps you from over- or under-buying, promotions and loyalty bring customers back without extra staff work, and a synced ecommerce store means every online order is already reflected in your inventory instead of reconciled after the fact.


That's the difference between a POS that just processes transactions and one that actually runs your business alongside you.
